clusters.name: tier1-harness
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serial. Every story mutates attach.rs and the single new attach_e2e_tests.rs file, so parallel execution would guarantee merge conflicts and broken intermediate compiles. The stories are also strictly ordered: refactor (US-001) -> scaffolding + first scenario (US-002) -> approval scenarios (US-003) -> abort/AEAD/default-off scenarios (US-004).
